Headline: Green and Pink Line Delays
ShortDescription: Green & Pink Line trains are operating w/residual delays after an earlier raised bridge at the Chicago River, downtown. Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Some Green and Pink Line trains are operating with residual delays after an earlier raised bridge at the Chicago River, downtown.

Shuttle buses are available to provide connecting service through the affected area from Clark/Lake to Ashland/Lake on the Green Line.

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored. Allow extra travel time.
